parameters.content:
## Amazon Multi-Domain Product Price & Detail Scraper

**Actor:** [Amazon Multi-Domain Product Price & Detail Scraper](https://apify.com/nimbryxo-studio/amazon-multi-domain-product-price-and-detail)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/amazon-multi-domain-product-price-and-detail-scraper.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `productUrls` (array)
- `asins` (array)
- `searchTerms` (array)
- `searchUrls` (array)
- `bestsellerUrls` (array)
- `marketplace` (string)
- `domains` (array)
- `language` (string)
- `currency` (string)
- `deliveryCountry` (string)
- `postalCode` (string)
- `minPrice` (number)

### Output fields
- `title` (Product Title)
- `asin` (ASIN)
- `price` (Price)
- `stars` (Rating)
- `reviewsCount` (Reviews)
- `inStock` (In Stock)
- `brand` (Brand)
- `url` (URL)

description: Amazon price tracking: runs the Amazon Multi-Domain Product Price & Detail Scraper Apify Actor, returns title, asin, price, stars, reviewsCount and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
